title: One Stamp, Every Slip
request: Each tile holds the late days for one book. Deliver a tray of fees at two ink drops per day, in the same order.
objective: Apply arithmetic to a whole array without a loop.
starter:
# days is an array: the stamp can sweep the entire tray.
deliver(days)
hints: Every tile needs the same rate, even when the tray grows.
Array multiplication applies the rate to every element.
Create a new fees name from days and the rate, then deliver that new tray.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import make_array
days = make_array(*[random.randint(1, 14) for _ in range(random.randint(2, 7))])
